sourceEvidence.quote: CH50 tests classical pathway (C1, C2, C4); ↓ in SLE, immune complex diseases, C2/C4 deficiency.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
AH50 tests alternative pathway (factor D, B, properdin); ↓ in properdin, factor D/B deficiency,
Neisseria infections.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
CH50 + AH50 test common/terminal pathways (C3, C5-C9); ↓ in terminal pathway defect (C5-C9)
or complement consumption (eg, sepsis, autoimmune disease).
